async function populateMockAppointments(db) {
  const appointmentsCollection = db.collection('appointments');
  const count = await appointmentsCollection.countDocuments();
  if (count === 0) {
    const usersCollection = db.collection('users');
    const doctorsCollection = db.collection('doctors');
    const patient = await usersCollection.findOne({ role: 'patient' });
    const doctors = await doctorsCollection.find().limit(5).toArray();
    if (!patient || doctors.length === 0) {
      console.log('No patients or doctors found, skipping appointment creation');
      return;
    }
    const patientId = patient._id.toString();
    const reasons = [
      'Annual Check-up', 'Follow-up Consultation', 'Medication Review',
      'Flu Symptoms', 'Back Pain', 'Heart Palpitations', 'Skin Rash', 'Allergies'
    ];
    const mockAppointments = [];
    const today = new Date();
    // Past appointments
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const appointmentDate = new Date(today);
      appointmentDate.setDate(today.getDate() - (i + 1) * 7);
      const doctor = doctors[Math.floor(Math.random() * doctors.length)];
      const startHour = 9 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
      const startMinute = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) * 15;
      mockAppointments.push({
        patientId,
        doctorId: doctor._id.toString(),
        doctorName: doctor.fullName,
        date: appointmentDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
        startTime: `${startHour.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${startMinute.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
        endTime: `${(startHour + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${startMinute.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
        type: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'in-person' : 'video',
        status: 'completed',
        reason: reasons[Math.floor(Math.random() * reasons.length)],
        notes: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'Patient responded well to treatment.' : null,
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date()
      });
    }
    // Upcoming appointments
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const appointmentDate = new Date(today);
      appointmentDate.setDate(today.getDate() + (i + 1) * 7);
      const doctor = doctors[Math.floor(Math.random() * doctors.length)];
      const startHour = 9 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
      const startMinute = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) * 15;
      mockAppointments.push({
        patientId,
        doctorId: doctor._id.toString(),
        doctorName: doctor.fullName,
        date: appointmentDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
        startTime: `${startHour.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${startMinute.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
        endTime: `${(startHour + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${startMinute.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
        type: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'in-person' : 'video',
        status: 'scheduled',
        reason: reasons[Math.floor(Math.random() * reasons.length)],
        notes: null,
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date()
      });
    }
    const result = await appointmentsCollection.insertMany(mockAppointments);
    console.log(`${result.insertedCount} mock appointments inserted`);
  } else {
    console.log('Appointments collection already has data, skipping mock data insertion');
  }
}
async function populateMockPrescriptions(db) {
  const prescriptionsCollection = db.collection('prescriptions');
  const count = await prescriptionsCollection.countDocuments();
  if (count === 0) {
    const usersCollection = db.collection('users');
    const doctorsCollection = db.collection('doctors');
    const patient = await usersCollection.findOne({ role: 'patient' });
    const doctors = await doctorsCollection.find().limit(5).toArray();
    if (!patient || doctors.length === 0) {
      console.log('No patients or doctors found, skipping prescription creation');
      return;
    }
    const patientId = patient._id.toString();
    const medications = [
      { name: 'Lisinopril', class: 'ACE Inhibitor', commonUse: 'High blood pressure' },
      { name: 'Atorvastatin', class: 'Statin', commonUse: 'High cholesterol' },
      { name: 'Levothyroxine', class: 'Thyroid hormone', commonUse: 'Hypothyroidism' },
      { name: 'Metformin', class: 'Biguanide', commonUse: 'Type 2 diabetes' },
      { name: 'Amlodipine', class: 'Calcium channel blocker', commonUse: 'High blood pressure' }
    ];
    const mockPrescriptions = [];
    const today = new Date();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const prescribedDate = new Date(today);
      prescribedDate.setDate(today.getDate() - Math.floor(Math.random() * 90));
      const durationMonths = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
      const expiryDate = new Date(prescribedDate);
      expiryDate.setMonth(expiryDate.getMonth() + durationMonths);
      const isActive = expiryDate > today;
      const doctor = doctors[Math.floor(Math.random() * doctors.length)];
      const numMeds = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) + 1;
      const prescriptionMeds = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < numMeds; j++) {
        const med = medications[Math.floor(Math.random() * medications.length)];
        prescriptionMeds.push({
          name: med.name,
          dosage: `${(Math.random() * 200 + 10).toFixed(0)} mg Tablet`,
          frequency: `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1} time(s) daily`,
          instructions: 'Take with food',
          refills: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3),
          medicationClass: med.class,
          commonUses: [med.commonUse]
        });
      }
      mockPrescriptions.push({
        patientId,
        doctorId: doctor._id.toString(),
        doctorName: doctor.fullName,
        medications: prescriptionMeds,
        prescribedDate: prescribedDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
        expiryDate: expiryDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
        refillsRemaining: Math.floor(Math.random() * 4),
        status: isActive ? 'active' : 'expired',
        pharmacyId: new ObjectId().toString(),
        pharmacyName: 'MedConnect Pharmacy',
        notes: null,
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date()
      });
    }
    const result = await prescriptionsCollection.insertMany(mockPrescriptions);
    console.log(`${result.insertedCount} mock prescriptions inserted`);
  } else {
    console.log('Prescriptions collection already has data, skipping mock data insertion');
  }
}
async function populateMockReminders(db) {
  const remindersCollection = db.collection('reminders');
  const count = await remindersCollection.countDocuments();
  if (count === 0) {
    const usersCollection = db.collection('users');
    const patient = await usersCollection.findOne({ role: 'patient' });
    if (!patient) {
      console.log('No patients found, skipping reminder creation');
      return;
    }
    const patientId = patient._id.toString();
    const reminderTypes = ['medication', 'appointment', 'test', 'vitals'];
    const today = new Date();
    const mockReminders = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const reminderDate = new Date(today);
      reminderDate.setDate(today.getDate() + Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) - 5);
      const reminderType = reminderTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * reminderTypes.length)];
      let title, description;
      switch (reminderType) {
        case 'medication':
          title = `Take ${['Aspirin', 'Lisinopril', 'Metformin'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)]}`;
          description = `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1} tablet(s) with food`;
          break;
        case 'appointment':
          title = 'Doctor Appointment';
          description = 'Follow-up consultation';
          break;
        case 'test':
          title = `${['Blood test', 'Urine test', 'X-ray'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)]}`;
          description = 'Fasting required';
          break;
        case 'vitals':
          title = `Record ${['blood pressure', 'heart rate', 'blood sugar'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)]}`;
          description = 'Regular monitoring required';
          break;
      }
      mockReminders.push({
        patientId,
        title,
        description,
        reminder_type: reminderType,
        date: reminderDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
        time: `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 24).toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${Math.floor(Math.random() * 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
        recurring: Math.random() > 0.5,
        frequency: 'daily',
        status: reminderDate < today ? 'completed' : 'pending',
        created_at: new Date(today.getTime() - 86400000 * 10).toISOString(),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }
    const result = await remindersCollection.insertMany(mockReminders);
    console.log(`${result.insertedCount} mock reminders inserted`);
  } else {
    console.log('Reminders collection already has data, skipping mock data insertion');
  }
}
async function populateMockVitalSigns(db) {
  const vitalSignsCollection = db.collection('vitalSigns');
  const count = await vitalSignsCollection.countDocuments();
  if (count === 0) {
    const usersCollection = db.collection('users');
    const patient = await usersCollection.findOne({ role: 'patient' });
    if (!patient) {
      console.log('No patients found, skipping vital signs creation');
      return;
    }
    const patientId = patient._id.toString();
    const today = new Date();
    const mockVitalSigns = [];
    // Blood pressure readings
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const recordDate = new Date(today);
      recordDate.setDate(today.getDate() - i * 3);
      const systolic = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 110;
      const diastolic = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 70;
      mockVitalSigns.push({
        patientId,
        recordedAt: recordDate.toISOString(),
        vitalType: 'blood_pressure',
        value: `${systolic}/${diastolic}`,
        unit: 'mmHg',
        isAbnormal: systolic > 130 || diastolic > 85,
        source: 'manual',
        createdAt: recordDate,
        updatedAt: recordDate
      });
    }
    // Heart rate readings
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const recordDate = new Date(today);
      recordDate.setDate(today.getDate() - i * 2);
      const heartRate = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 60;
      mockVitalSigns.push({
        patientId,
        recordedAt: recordDate.toISOString(),
        vitalType: 'heart_rate',
        value: heartRate,
        unit: 'bpm',
        isAbnormal: heartRate > 100 || heartRate < 60,
        source: 'manual',
        createdAt: recordDate,
        updatedAt: recordDate
      });
    }
    // Weight readings
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const recordDate = new Date(today);
      recordDate.setDate(today.getDate() - i * 7);
      const weight = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 70;
      mockVitalSigns.push({
        patientId,
        recordedAt: recordDate.toISOString(),
        vitalType: 'weight',
        value: weight,
        unit: 'kg',
        isAbnormal: false,
        source: 'manual',
        createdAt: recordDate,
        updatedAt: recordDate
      });
    }
    const result = await vitalSignsCollection.insertMany(mockVitalSigns);
    console.log(`${result.insertedCount} mock vital signs inserted`);
  } else {
    console.log('Vital signs collection already has data, skipping mock data insertion');
  }
}
async function populateMockLabResults(db) {
  const labResultsCollection = db.collection('labResults');
  const count = await labResultsCollection.countDocuments();
  if (count === 0) {
    const usersCollection = db.collection('users');
    const patient = await usersCollection.findOne({ role: 'patient' });
    if (!patient) {
      console.log('No patients found, skipping lab results creation');
      return;
    }
    const patientId = patient._id.toString();
    const today = new Date();
    const testTypes = [
      'Complete Blood Count (CBC)',
      'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)',
      'Lipid Panel',
      'Thyroid Function Tests'
    ];
    const mockLabResults = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const resultDate = new Date(today);
      resultDate.setDate(today.getDate() - i * 30);
      const testName = testTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * testTypes.length)];
      const isNormal = Math.random() > 0.3;
      const mockResult = {
        patientId,
        test_name: testName,
        test_type: testName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_'),
        result_date: resultDate.toISOString(),
        is_normal: isNormal,
        conclusion: isNormal ? 'Results are within normal range.' : 'Minor abnormality detected. Monitoring advised.',
        details: {
          performed_by: 'Dr. Johnson',
          lab_name: 'MedConnect Labs'
        },
        file_url: null,
        created_at: resultDate.toISOString(),
        updated_at: resultDate.toISOString(),
        parameters: []
      };
      // Add test-specific parameters
      if (testName.includes('Blood Count')) {
        mockResult.parameters = [
          { name: 'WBC', value: `${(Math.random() * 5 + 4).toFixed(1)}`, unit: 'x10^9/L', reference: '4.5-11.0', is_normal: Math.random() > 0.2 },
          { name: 'RBC', value: `${(Math.random() * 2 + 3.5).toFixed(2)}`, unit: 'x10^12/L', reference: '4.5-6.5', is_normal: Math.random() > 0.2 },
          { name: 'Hemoglobin', value: `${(Math.random() * 4 + 11).toFixed(1)}`, unit: 'g/dL', reference: '12-18', is_normal: Math.random() > 0.2 },
          { name: 'Platelets', value: `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 150 + 150)}`, unit: 'x10^9/L', reference: '150-450', is_normal: Math.random() > 0.2 }
        ];
      } else if (testName.includes('Lipid')) {
        mockResult.parameters = [
          { name: 'Total Cholesterol', value: `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 150)}`, unit: 'mg/dL', reference: '<200', is_normal: Math.random() > 0.3 },
          { name: 'LDL', value: `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 60 + 70)}`, unit: 'mg/dL', reference: '<100', is_normal: Math.random() > 0.3 },
          { name: 'HDL', value: `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 30 + 40)}`, unit: 'mg/dL', reference: '>40', is_normal: Math.random() > 0.3 },
          { name: 'Triglycerides', value: `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100 + 50)}`, unit: 'mg/dL', reference: '<150', is_normal: Math.random() > 0.3 }
        ];
      }
      mockLabResults.push(mockResult);
    }
    const result = await labResultsCollection.insertMany(mockLabResults);
    console.log(`${result.insertedCount} mock lab results inserted`);
  } else {
    console.log('Lab results collection already has data, skipping mock data insertion');
  }
}
// Run the setup
setupDatabase().catch(console.error);
</file>

<file path="scripts/start-mongodb.sh">
#!/bin/bash
# Start MongoDB using Docker for local development
# Usage: ./scripts/start-mongodb.sh
# Check if Docker is installed
if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then
  echo "❌ Docker is not installed. Please install Docker first."
  exit 1
fi
# Container name
CONTAINER_NAME="healcard-mongodb"
# Check if container already exists
if docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q "^${CONTAINER_NAME}$"; then
  # Check if it's running
  if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q "^${CONTAINER_NAME}$"; then
    echo "✅ MongoDB container is already running."
    echo "MongoDB is available at mongodb://localhost:27017/healcard"
    exit 0
  else
    # Container exists but not running, start it
    echo "📦 Starting existing MongoDB container..."
    docker start ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    echo "✅ MongoDB container started."
    echo "MongoDB is available at mongodb://localhost:27017/healcard"
    exit 0
  fi
fi
# Create and start a new MongoDB container
echo "🔄 Creating and starting new MongoDB container..."
docker run --name ${CONTAINER_NAME} \
  -p 27017:27017 \
  -v healcard-mongodb-data:/data/db \
  -d \
  mongo:latest
# Check if container started successfully
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "✅ MongoDB container started successfully."
  echo "MongoDB is available at mongodb://localhost:27017/healcard"
  echo ""
  echo "To seed the symptoms database, run: npm run seed-symptoms"
  echo "To stop MongoDB, run: docker stop ${CONTAINER_NAME}"
else
  echo "❌ Failed to start MongoDB container."
  exit 1
fi
</file>

<file path="scripts/test-symptom-data.js">
// Test script to insert symptom tracker data directly into MongoDB
const { MongoClient } = require('mongodb');
require('dotenv').config();
async function main() {
  // Connection URL
  const uri = process.env.MONGODB_URI;
  if (!uri) {
    console.error('MONGODB_URI environment variable is not set');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('Connecting to MongoDB...');
  // Create a new MongoClient
  const client = new MongoClient(uri);
  try {
    // Connect to the MongoDB server
    await client.connect();
    console.log('Connected to MongoDB successfully');
    // Get the database
    const db = client.db();
    // Create test analytics data
    const analyticsData = [
      {
        action: 'symptom_check_started',
        data: {
          sessionId: 'test_session_123',
          timestamp: new Date()
        },
        clientIp: '127.0.0.1',
        userAgent: 'Test Script',
        createdAt: new Date()
      },
      {
        action: 'symptom_check_bodypart_selected',
        data: {
          sessionId: 'test_session_123',
          bodyPart: 'Head',
          timestamp: new Date()
        },
        clientIp: '127.0.0.1',
        userAgent: 'Test Script',
        createdAt: new Date()
      },
      {
        action: 'symptom_check_completed',
        data: {
          sessionId: 'test_session_123',
          symptoms: ['Headache', 'Fever', 'Fatigue'],
          timestamp: new Date()
        },
        clientIp: '127.0.0.1',
        userAgent: 'Test Script',
        createdAt: new Date()
      },
      {
        action: 'symptom_check_feedback',
        data: {
          sessionId: 'test_session_123',
          isHelpful: true,
          symptoms: ['Headache', 'Fever'],
          timestamp: new Date()
        },
        clientIp: '127.0.0.1',
        userAgent: 'Test Script',
        createdAt: new Date()
      }
    ];
    // Create test symptom check data
    const symptomCheckData = {
      _id: 'test_session_123',
      symptoms: ['Headache', 'Fever', 'Fatigue'],
      bodyPart: 'Head',
      prediction: {
        possibleCauses: ['Common Cold', 'Influenza', 'Migraine']
      },
      feedback: 'helpful',
      hasReports: false,
      completed: true,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      completedAt: new Date(),
      feedbackAt: new Date()
    };
    // Insert analytics data
    console.log('Inserting analytics data...');
    const analyticsResult = await db.collection('analytics').insertMany(analyticsData);
    console.log(`Inserted ${analyticsResult.insertedCount} analytics documents`);
    // Insert symptom check data
    console.log('Inserting symptom check data...');
    const symptomCheckResult = await db.collection('symptomChecks').insertOne(symptomCheckData);
    console.log(`Inserted symptom check document with ID: ${symptomCheckResult.insertedId}`);
    console.log('Test data inserted successfully');
  } finally {
    // Close the connection
    await client.close();
    console.log('MongoDB connection closed');
  }
}
main().catch(console.error);

<file path="src/features/auth/screens/LoginScreen.tsx">
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { View, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, Image, Alert } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { signInWithEmail } from '../../../services/firebase';
import { theme } from '../../../theme';
const LoginScreen = ({ navigation }: any) => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const handleLogin = async () => {
    if (!email || !password) {
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Please enter both email and password');
      return;
    }
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await signInWithEmail(email, password);
      // Navigation will be handled by the auth state listener in AppNavigator
    } catch (error: any) {
      Alert.alert('Login Failed', error.message || 'Please check your credentials and try again');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.content}>
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>MedConnect</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Your Health, Connected</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.form}>
          <View style={styles.inputContainer}>
            <Text style={styles.label}>Email</Text>
            <TextInput
              style={styles.input}
              placeholder="Enter your email"
              value={email}
              onChangeText={setEmail}
              keyboardType="email-address"
              autoCapitalize="none"
            />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.inputContainer}>
            <Text style={styles.label}>Password</Text>
            <TextInput
              style={styles.input}
              placeholder="Enter your password"
              value={password}
              onChangeText={setPassword}
              secureTextEntry
            />
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.forgotPassword}
            onPress={() => {}}
          >
            <Text style={styles.forgotPasswordText}>Forgot Password?</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.button, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleLogin}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            <Text style={styles.buttonText}>
              {isLoading ? 'Logging in...' : 'Login'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <View style={styles.divider}>

          </View>

            style={styles.googleButton}
            onPress={() => {}}
          >
            <Text style={styles.googleButtonText}>Continue with Google</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <Text style={styles.footerText}>Don't have an account? </Text>

import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { theme } from '../../../theme';
// Mock data for providers
const mockProviders = [
  {
    id: '1',
    name: 'Dr. Sarah Johnson',
    specialty: 'Cardiologist',
    rating: 4.8,
    distance: '2.3 miles',
    available: true,
  },
  {
    id: '2',
    name: 'Dr. Michael Chen',
    specialty: 'Dermatologist',
    rating: 4.7,
    distance: '1.5 miles',
    available: true,
  },
  {
    id: '3',
    name: 'Dr. Emily Rodriguez',
    specialty: 'Pediatrician',
    rating: 4.9,
    distance: '3.1 miles',

    name: 'Dr. James Wilson',
    specialty: 'Orthopedic Surgeon',
    rating: 4.6,
    distance: '4.2 miles',
    available: true,
  },
  {
    id: '5',
    name: 'Dr. Lisa Thompson',
    specialty: 'Neurologist',
    rating: 4.5,
    distance: '2.8 miles',
    available: true,
  },
];
const ProviderSearchScreen = ({ navigation }: any) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filteredProviders, setFilteredProviders] = useState(mockProviders);
  const handleSearch = (text: string) => {
    setSearchQuery(text);
    if (text.trim() === '') {
      setFilteredProviders(mockProviders);
    } else {
      const filtered = mockProviders.filter(
        provider => 
          provider.name.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase()) ||
          provider.specialty.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase())
      );
      setFilteredProviders(filtered);
    }
  };
  const renderProviderItem = ({ item }: { item: any }) => (
    <TouchableOpacity 
      style={styles.providerCard}
      onPress={() => {}}
    >
      <View style={styles.providerInfo}>
        <Text style={styles.providerName}>{item.name}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.providerSpecialty}>{item.specialty}</Text>
        <View style={styles.providerDetails}>
          <Text style={styles.providerRating}>★ {item.rating}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.providerDistance}>{item.distance}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.availabilityContainer}>
        <View style={[
          styles.availabilityIndicator, 
          { backgroundColor: item.available ? theme.colors.success : theme.colors.error }
        ]} />
        <Text style={styles.availabilityText}>
          {item.available ? 'Available' : 'Unavailable'}
        </Text>
        <TouchableOpacity 
          style={[
            styles.bookButton,
            !item.available && styles.bookButtonDisabled
          ]}
          disabled={!item.available}
          onPress={() => {}}
        >
          <Text style={styles.bookButtonText}>Book</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>Find Providers</Text>
        <TextInput
          style={styles.searchInput}
          placeholder="Search by name or specialty"
          value={searchQuery}
          onChangeText={handleSearch}
        />
      </View>
      <View style={styles.filtersContainer}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
          <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Specialty</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
          <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Distance</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
          <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Availability</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
          <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Rating</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
      <FlatList
        data={filteredProviders}
        renderItem={renderProviderItem}
        keyExtractor={item => item.id}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.providersList}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <View style={styles.emptyContainer}>
            <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No providers found</Text>
          </View>
        }
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

<file path="src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx">
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { NavigationContainer } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { createNativeStackNavigator } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';
import { createBottomTabNavigator } from '@react-navigation/bottom-tabs';
import MaterialIcon from 'react-native-vector-icons/MaterialCommunityIcons';
import { ActivityIndicator, View, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { onAuthStateChanged } from 'firebase/auth';
import { auth } from '../services/firebase';
import { theme } from '../theme';
// Import necessary screens
import LoginScreen from '../features/auth/screens/LoginScreen';
import HomeScreen from '../features/home/screens/HomeScreen';
import ProviderSearchScreen from '../features/providers/screens/ProviderSearchScreen';
import EmergencyScreen from '../features/emergency/screens/EmergencyScreen';
// Define types
type AuthStackParamList = {
  Login: undefined;
};
type HomeStackParamList = {
  Home: undefined;
};
type SearchStackParamList = {
  ProviderSearch: undefined;
};
type EmergencyStackParamList = {
  Emergency: undefined;
};
type MainTabParamList = {
  HomeTab: undefined;
  SearchTab: undefined;
  EmergencyTab: undefined;
};
// Create navigators
const AuthStack = createNativeStackNavigator<AuthStackParamList>();
const HomeStack = createNativeStackNavigator<HomeStackParamList>();
const SearchStack = createNativeStackNavigator<SearchStackParamList>();
const EmergencyStack = createNativeStackNavigator<EmergencyStackParamList>();
const MainTab = createBottomTabNavigator<MainTabParamList>();
// Stack navigators for each tab
const HomeStackNavigator = () => (
  <HomeStack.Navigator screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }}>
    <HomeStack.Screen name="Home" component={HomeScreen} />
  </HomeStack.Navigator>
);
const SearchStackNavigator = () => (
  <SearchStack.Navigator>
    <SearchStack.Screen 
      name="ProviderSearch" 
      component={ProviderSearchScreen} 
      options={{ title: 'Find Providers' }}
    />
  </SearchStack.Navigator>
);
const EmergencyStackNavigator = () => (
  <EmergencyStack.Navigator>
    <EmergencyStack.Screen 
      name="Emergency" 
      component={EmergencyScreen} 
      options={{ title: 'Emergency' }}
    />
  </EmergencyStack.Navigator>
);
// Tab Navigator
const MainTabNavigator = () => (
  <MainTab.Navigator
    screenOptions={({ route }) => ({
      tabBarIcon: ({ color, size }) => {
        let iconName;
        if (route.name === 'HomeTab') {
          iconName = 'home';
        } else if (route.name === 'SearchTab') {
          iconName = 'magnify';
        } else if (route.name === 'EmergencyTab') {
          iconName = 'medical-bag';
        }
        return <MaterialIcon name={iconName || 'help-circle'} size={size} color={color} />;
      },
      tabBarActiveTintColor: theme.colors.primary,
      tabBarInactiveTintColor: theme.colors.text.secondary,
    })}
  >
    <MainTab.Screen 
      name="HomeTab" 
      component={HomeStackNavigator} 
      options={{ title: 'Home', headerShown: false }}
    />
    <MainTab.Screen 
      name="SearchTab" 
      component={SearchStackNavigator} 
      options={{ title: 'Find Care', headerShown: false }}
    />
    <MainTab.Screen 
      name="EmergencyTab" 
      component={EmergencyStackNavigator} 
      options={{ title: 'Emergency', headerShown: false }}
    />
  </MainTab.Navigator>
);
// Auth Navigator
const AuthNavigator = () => (
  <AuthStack.Navigator screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }}>
    <AuthStack.Screen name="Login" component={LoginScreen} />
  </AuthStack.Navigator>
);
// Loading component
const LoadingScreen = () => (
  <View style={styles.center}>
    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={theme.colors.primary} />
  </View>
);
// Main App Navigator
const AppNavigator = () => {
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
      setUser(user);
      setIsLoading(false);
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);
  if (isLoading) {
    return <LoadingScreen />;
  }
  return (
    <NavigationContainer>
      {user ? <MainTabNavigator /> : <AuthNavigator />}
    </NavigationContainer>
  );
};
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  center: {
    flex: 1,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: theme.colors.background,
  },
});
export default AppNavigator;
</file>

import { initializeApp } from 'firebase/app';
import {

  createUserWithEmailAndPassword, 
  signInWithEmailAndPassword, 
  signOut as firebaseSignOut,
  sendPasswordResetEmail
} from 'firebase/auth';
import { 
  getFirestore, 
  collection, 
  doc, 
  setDoc, 
  getDoc, 
  updateDoc
} from 'firebase/firestore';
import { 
  getStorage, 
  ref, 
  uploadBytes, 
  getDownloadURL,
  deleteObject 
} from 'firebase/storage';
import { getAnalytics } from 'firebase/analytics';
// Firebase configuration
const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: "AIzaSyArRXrywCQ8Kpzf6ahk35ZmiPjR5a_W4m8",
  authDomain: "med-connect-akshit.firebaseapp.com",
  projectId: "med-connect-akshit",
  storageBucket: "med-connect-akshit.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId: "86172999401",
  appId: "1:86172999401:web:d38c97b0c89ba29d6f1a78",
  measurementId: "G-FKXK5SRD6M"
};
// Initialize Firebase
const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
// Initialize Firebase services
const auth = getAuth(app);
const firestore = getFirestore(app);
const storage = getStorage(app);
const analytics = getAnalytics(app);
// Authentication methods
export const signUpWithEmail = async (email: string, password: string) => {
  try {
    return await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
export const signInWithEmail = async (email: string, password: string) => {
  try {
    return await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
export const signOut = async () => {
  try {
    await firebaseSignOut(auth);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
export const resetPassword = async (email: string) => {
  try {
    await sendPasswordResetEmail(auth, email);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
// Firestore methods
export const createUserProfile = async (userId: string, userData: any) => {
  try {
    const userRef = doc(collection(firestore, 'users'), userId);
    await setDoc(userRef, userData);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
export const getUserProfile = async (userId: string) => {
  try {
    const userRef = doc(collection(firestore, 'users'), userId);
    const docSnap = await getDoc(userRef);
    return docSnap.exists() ? docSnap.data() : null;
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
export const updateUserProfile = async (userId: string, userData: any) => {
  try {
    const userRef = doc(collection(firestore, 'users'), userId);
    await updateDoc(userRef, userData);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
// Storage methods
export const uploadFile = async (uri: string, path: string) => {
  try {
    const storageRef = ref(storage, path);
    // Note: For React Native, you need to convert the file URI to a Blob or File first
    // This is a simplified example
    const response = await fetch(uri);
    const blob = await response.blob();
    await uploadBytes(storageRef, blob);
    return await getDownloadURL(storageRef);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
export const deleteFile = async (path: string) => {
  try {
    const storageRef = ref(storage, path);
    await deleteObject(storageRef);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};
// Export Firebase services
export { 
  app, 
  auth, 
  firestore, 
  storage, 
  analytics 
};

<file path="API-ENDPOINTS.md">
# MedConnect API Endpoints

This document outlines all API endpoints for the MedConnect platform, organized by feature area.

## Authentication & User Management

### Authentication 
POST /api/auth/register // Register new user
POST /api/auth/login // User login
POST /api/auth/logout // User logout
POST /api/auth/refresh-token // Refresh authentication token
POST /api/auth/forgot-password // Request password reset
POST /api/auth/reset-password // Reset password with token
POST /api/auth/verify-email // Verify email address


### User Profile
GET /api/users/me // Get current user profile
PUT /api/users/me // Update user profile
GET /api/users/me/family // Get family members
POST /api/users/me/family // Add family member
PUT /api/users/me/family/{id} // Update family member
DELETE /api/users/me/family/{id} // Remove family member
PUT /api/users/me/profile-picture // Update profile picture
GET /api/users/me/notifications // Get user notifications
PUT /api/users/me/notifications/{id}/read // Mark notification as read
PUT /api/users/me/preferences // Update user preferences
Management

## Health Passport

### Passport Management

POST /api/health-passport/create // Create new passport
GET /api/health-passport/{user_id} // Get user's passport
PUT /api/health-passport/{passport_id} // Update passport
DELETE /api/health-passport/{passport_id} // Delete passport (soft delete)


### Medical Records

POST /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/records // Add medical record
GET /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/records // Get all records
GET /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/records/{record_id} // Get specific record
PUT /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/records/{record_id} // Update record
DELETE /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/records/{record_id} // Delete record


### Vital Signs
POST /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/vitals // Add vital signs
GET /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/vitals // Get vital history
DELETE /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/vitals/{vital_id} // Delete vital entry


### Access Management

POST /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/access // Generate access code/QR
GET /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/access-logs // Get access history
POST /api/health-passport/access/{access_code} // Access with code
POST /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/request-access // Request access as provider
GET /api/health-passport/{passport_id}/access-requests // Get pending requests
PUT /api/health-passport/access-requests/{request_id} // Approve/reject request


## Imaging Services

### Service Catalog

GET /api/imaging/services // Get all imaging services
GET /api/imaging/services/{category} // Get services by category
GET /api/imaging/services/{service_id} // Get service details


### Providers
GET /api/imaging/providers // Get all imaging providers
GET /api/imaging/providers/nearby // Get providers by location
GET /api/imaging/providers/{provider_id} // Get provider details
GET /api/imaging/providers/{provider_id}/services // Get services offered by provider
GET /api/imaging/providers/{provider_id}/availability // Get available slots


### Appointments
POST /api/imaging/appointments // Book new appointment
GET /api/imaging/appointments/user/{user_id} // Get user's appointments
GET /api/imaging/appointments/{appointment_id} // Get appointment details

# MedConnect Developer Guide

## Welcome to MedConnect!

This guide will help you get started with the MedConnect platform codebase. Whether you're a frontend developer, backend developer, or full-stack engineer, this document will provide you with everything you need to set up your development environment and start contributing to the project.

## Table of Contents

1. [Technology Stack](#technology-stack)
2. [Getting Started](#getting-started)
3. [Project Structure](#project-structure)
4. [Development Workflow](#development-workflow)
5. [API Documentation](#api-documentation)
6. [Authentication](#authentication)
7. [Database Management](#database-management)
8. [Testing](#testing)
9. [Deployment](#deployment)
10. [Coding Standards](#coding-standards)
11. [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Technology Stack

MedConnect is built using the following technologies:

### Frontend
- **React**: UI library for building component-based interfaces
- **Next.js**: React framework for server-side rendering and routing
- **Tailwind CSS**: Utility-first CSS framework for styling
- **TypeScript**: Type-safe JavaScript
- **React Context API**: For state management
- **Chart.js**: For data visualization

### Backend
- **Next.js API Routes**: Serverless functions for API endpoints
- **MongoDB**: NoSQL database for data storage
- **JWT**: For authentication and authorization
- **Socket.io**: For real-time features (coming in Phase 3)

### DevOps & Tools
- **Git**: Version control
- **GitHub Actions**: CI/CD pipeline
- **Vercel**: Hosting and deployment
- **MongoDB Atlas**: Cloud database hosting
- **ESLint**: Code linting
- **Prettier**: Code formatting

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Node.js (v14 or higher)
- npm or yarn
- Git
- MongoDB (local instance for development)
- An IDE (VS Code recommended)

### Installation

1. **Clone the repository**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/your-org/medconnect.git
cd medconnect
```

2. **Install dependencies**

```bash
npm install
# or
yarn install
```

3. **Set up environment variables**

Create a `.env.local` file in the root directory with the following variables:

```
# MongoDB
MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/medconnect
MONGODB_DB=medconnect

# Authentication
JWT_SECRET=your_jwt_secret_here
JWT_EXPIRES_IN=7d

# API URLs
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3000/api
```

4. **Run the development server**

```bash
npm run dev
# or
yarn dev
```

The application will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).

## Project Structure

The MedConnect codebase follows a feature-based structure:

```
medconnect/
├── app/                  # Next.js app directory
│   ├── api/              # API routes
│   │   ├── auth/         # Authentication endpoints
│   │   ├── health-passport/ # Health Passport endpoints
│   │   └── imaging/      # Imaging services endpoints
│   ├── components/       # React components
│   │   ├── common/       # Shared components
│   │   ├── dashboard/    # Dashboard components
│   │   ├── health-passport/ # Health Passport components
│   │   └── imaging/      # Imaging service components
│   ├── lib/              # Utility functions and services
│   │   ├── models/       # Data models
│   │   ├── services/     # Service modules
│   │   └── utils.ts      # Utility functions
│   ├── (routes)/         # Frontend routes
│   └── layout.tsx        # Root layout
├── public/               # Static assets
├── styles/               # Global styles
├── types/                # TypeScript type definitions
├── .env.local            # Environment variables
├── next.config.js        # Next.js configuration
└── package.json          # Project dependencies
```

## Development Workflow

### Branching Strategy

We follow a Git Flow branching strategy:

- `main`: Production-ready code
- `develop`: Integration branch for features
- `feature/*`: Feature branches
- `bugfix/*`: Bug fix branches
- `release/*`: Release branches
- `hotfix/*`: Hot fix branches

### Development Process

1. **Create a Feature Branch**

```bash
git checkout develop
git pull
git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name
```

2. **Make Changes and Commit**

```bash
git add .
git commit -m "feat: add your feature description"
```

We follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) for commit messages.

3. **Push Changes**

```bash
git push origin feature/your-feature-name
```

4. **Create a Pull Request**

Create a pull request from your feature branch to the `develop` branch through GitHub.

5. **Code Review and Merge**

After code review and approval, your PR will be merged into the `develop` branch.

## API Documentation

### API Structure

All API endpoints follow RESTful conventions and are located in the `app/api` directory. Each endpoint returns JSON data and uses standard HTTP status codes.

### Common Endpoints

See the dedicated API documentation in each API directory:

- Authentication: `/app/api/auth/README.md`
- Health Passport: `/app/api/health-passport/README.md`
- Imaging Services: `/app/api/imaging/README.md`

### Error Handling

All API endpoints return standardized error responses:

```json
{
  "error": "Error message describing the issue"
}
```

HTTP status codes:
- `200`: Success
- `400`: Bad Request
- `401`: Unauthorized
- `403`: Forbidden
- `404`: Not Found
- `500`: Internal Server Error

## Authentication

MedConnect uses JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for authentication. The authentication flow is:

1. User logs in or registers through `/api/auth/login` or `/api/auth/register`
2. The server validates credentials and returns a JWT token
3. The client stores the token in local storage
4. For each subsequent request, the client includes the token in the Authorization header

Authentication utilities can be found in `app/lib/auth-utils.ts`.

## Database Management

### MongoDB Models

Data models are defined in `app/lib/models/` directory. The main collections are:

- Users
- HealthPassports
- MedicalRecords
- ImagingProviders
- ImagingAppointments
- ImagingResults

### Database Connection

The database connection is managed in `app/lib/mongodb.ts`. The connection is automatically established when the application starts.

### Working with Data

Service modules in `app/lib/services/` provide methods for working with data:

```typescript
// Example: Get a health passport
import { getHealthPassportByUserId } from '@/app/lib/services/health-passport-service';

const passport = await getHealthPassportByUserId(userId);
```

## Testing

### Running Tests

```bash
# Run all tests
npm test

# Run tests in watch mode
npm test -- --watch

# Run specific test file
npm test -- path/to/test/file.test.ts
```

### Writing Tests

Tests are located in `__tests__` directories next to the files they test. We use Jest and React Testing Library for testing.

```typescript
// Example test
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import HealthPassportCard from '@/app/components/health-passport/HealthPassportCard';

describe('HealthPassportCard', () => {
  it('renders the passport information', () => {
    render(<HealthPassportCard passport={mockPassport} />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Health Passport')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

## Deployment

The MedConnect application is deployed using Vercel. The deployment process is:

1. Changes are merged into the `develop` branch
2. A staging deployment is automatically triggered
3. After testing in staging, changes are merged into `main`
4. A production deployment is automatically triggered

### Environment Variables

Different environments (development, staging, production) use different sets of environment variables. These are managed in the Vercel dashboard.

## Coding Standards

We follow these coding standards:

### JavaScript/TypeScript

- Use TypeScript for all new code
- Use camelCase for variables and functions
- Use PascalCase for component names and classes
- Use async/await for asynchronous code
- Document complex functions with JSDoc comments

### CSS/Styling

- Use Tailwind CSS for styling
- Follow the design system in the `styles` directory
- Use the `clsx` library for conditional class names

### Component Structure

- One component per file
- Use functional components with hooks
- Extract reusable logic into custom hooks
- Keep components small and focused

## Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

#### MongoDB Connection Issues

If you're having trouble connecting to MongoDB:

1. Check that your MongoDB service is running
2. Verify your connection string in `.env.local`
3. Check for network issues or firewall settings

#### API Request Errors

If API requests are failing:

1. Check the browser console for error messages
2. Verify authentication token is valid
3. Check server logs for backend errors

#### Build Errors

If you encounter build errors:

1. Check for TypeScript errors
2. Verify all dependencies are installed
3. Clear the `.next` directory and rebuild

### Getting Help

If you're stuck, you can:

1. Check the documentation in this repository
2. Ask questions in the team Slack channel
3. Create an issue in GitHub
4. Reach out to the tech lead directly

---

## Contributing to the Documentation

This guide is a living document. If you find something missing or incorrect, please submit a pull request to improve it!

Thank you for joining the MedConnect development team. We're excited to have you on board!
</file>

## Project Overview

MedConnect is a comprehensive healthcare platform that connects patients with healthcare services through an intuitive interface. It prioritizes accessibility, transparency, and efficiency in healthcare delivery.

**Core Features:**
- Health Passport
- Appointment Scheduling
- Prescription Management
- Vital Signs Monitoring
- Lab Results
- Imaging Services
- Pharmacy Services
- Emergency Services

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Node.js (v16+)
- MongoDB (local or Atlas)
- npm

### Setup
1. Clone the repository
2. Run the setup script:
   ```bash
   ./setup.sh
   ```
   This script will:
   - Install dependencies
   - Create a `.env.local` file if it doesn't exist
   - Set up the database with initial data

3. Start the development server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

4. Access the application at http://localhost:3000

## Architecture

### Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 14, React 18, TailwindCSS
- **Backend**: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
- **Database**: MongoDB
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js
- **Styling**: TailwindCSS

### Project Structure
```
medconnect/
├── app/                   # Next.js app directory (App Router)
│   ├── api/               # API routes
│   ├── components/        # Shared components
│   ├── lib/               # Utility functions and services
│   ├── types/             # TypeScript type definitions
│   └── [feature]/         # Feature-specific pages

└── styles/                # Global styles
```

For a more detailed breakdown, see [PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md](PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md).

## Style Guidelines

### Color Theme
MedConnect uses a teal-based color scheme:

| Purpose | Color | Hex Code |
|---------|-------|----------|
| Primary | Teal | `#00897B` |
| Secondary | Light Teal | `#B2DFDB` |
| Accent | Blue | `#1E88E5` |
| Call-to-action | Bright Teal | `#00BCD4` |
| Background | Light Gray | `#F5F5F5` |
| Text | Dark Gray | `#212121` |

### TailwindCSS Configuration
Custom colors are defined in `tailwind.config.js`:

```javascript
theme: {
  extend: {
    colors: {
      primary: {
        DEFAULT: '#00897B',
        light: '#B2DFDB',
        dark: '#00695C',
      },
      secondary: {
        DEFAULT: '#1E88E5',
        light: '#BBDEFB',
        dark: '#1565C0',
      },
      action: {
        DEFAULT: '#00BCD4',
        hover: '#00ACC1',
      },
      background: '#F5F5F5',
      textPrimary: '#212121',
      textSecondary: '#757575',
    }
  }
}
```

### Typography
- **Headers**: Poppins (headings)
- **Body**: Inter (general text)
- **Accessibility**: Maintain a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1

### Component Guidelines
- Use functional components with hooks
- Follow atomic design principles (atoms, molecules, organisms)
- Maintain consistent spacing using Tailwind's spacing utilities
- Use responsive design for all components

### Code Style
- TypeScript for type safety
- ESLint and Prettier for code formatting
- Follow React best practices (React.memo for performance, proper key usage)

## API Documentation

MedConnect uses RESTful API endpoints to interact with the backend services.

### Base URL
- Development: `http://localhost:3000/api`
- Production: `https://medconnect.example.com/api`

### Authentication
- `POST /api/auth/register` - Register new user
- `POST /api/auth/login` - User login
- `POST /api/auth/logout` - User logout

### Health Passport
- `GET /api/health-passport` - Get user's health passport
- `POST /api/health-passport` - Create/update health passport

### Medical Records
- `GET /api/medical-records` - Get user's medical records
- `POST /api/medical-records` - Add new medical record

### Appointments
- `GET /api/appointments` - Get user's appointments
  - Query parameters:
    - `status`: Filter by status (upcoming, past, cancelled)
    - `from`: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - `to`: End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - `doctorId`: Filter by doctor
- `POST /api/appointments` - Book new appointment

### Prescriptions
- `GET /api/prescriptions` - Get user's prescriptions
  - Query parameters:
    - `status`: Filter by status (active, expired)
    - `from`: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - `to`: End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `POST /api/prescriptions` - Add new prescription

### Vital Signs
- `GET /api/vital-signs` - Get user's vital signs
  - Query parameters:
    - `type`: Vital sign type (blood_pressure, heart_rate, etc.)
    - `from`: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - `to`: End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `POST /api/vital-signs` - Add new vital sign record

### Lab Tests
- `GET /api/lab-tests/results` - Get user's lab test results
  - Query parameters:
    - `limit`: Number of results to return
    - `startDate`: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - `endDate`: End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - `type`: Test type

### Reminders
- `GET /api/reminders` - Get user's reminders
  - Query parameters:
    - `start`: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - `end`: End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - `type`: Reminder type
    - `status`: Reminder status
- `POST /api/reminders` - Add new reminder

## Database

### Connection
The application connects to MongoDB using the `DatabaseService` class:

```typescript
// app/lib/db-service.ts
import { MongoClient } from 'mongodb';

export class DatabaseService {
  private static client: MongoClient | null = null;
  
  static async getDb() {
    if (!this.client) {
      const uri = process.env.MONGODB_URI || 'mongodb://localhost:27017/medconnect';
      this.client = new MongoClient(uri);
      await this.client.connect();
    }
    
    return this.client.db();
  }
}
```

### Collections
The database consists of the following collections:

- `users` - User accounts and profiles
- `doctors` - Doctor profiles and availability
- `appointments` - Appointment bookings and details
- `prescriptions` - Prescription records
- `reminders` - Health reminders and notifications
- `vitalSigns` - Patient vital signs data
- `labResults` - Lab test results
- `healthPassports` - Patient health passports
- `medicalRecords` - Patient medical records
- `pharmacies` - Pharmacy information
- `medications` - Medication catalog
- `labTests` - Lab test catalog
- `imagingServices` - Imaging service catalog
- `emergencyServices` - Emergency service providers
- `reviews` - User reviews and ratings

### Data Models
TypeScript interfaces for all data models are defined in `app/types/api-types.ts`. These interfaces should be used for type safety across the application.

Examples:
```typescript
export interface User {
  _id: string;
  email: string;
  password?: string;
  fullName: string;
  dateOfBirth?: string;
  gender?: string;
  address?: string;
  phone?: string;
  role: 'patient' | 'doctor' | 'admin';
  specialty?: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

export interface Appointment {
  _id: string;
  patientId: string;
  doctorId: string;
  doctorName?: string;
  date: string;
  startTime: string;
  endTime: string;
  type: 'in-person' | 'video';
  status: 'scheduled' | 'completed' | 'cancelled' | 'no-show';
  reason: string;
  notes?: string | null;
  location?: {
    name: string;
    address: string;
    room: string;
  } | null;
  videoLink?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}
```

### Database Setup
To initialize the database with mock data:
```bash
npm run setup-db
```

This script creates all collections and populates them with sample data for development purposes.

## Authentication

MedConnect uses NextAuth.js for authentication:

### Configuration
The NextAuth configuration is in `app/lib/auth-options.ts`:

```typescript
import { NextAuthOptions } from "next-auth";
import CredentialsProvider from "next-auth/providers/credentials";
import { DatabaseService } from "./db-service";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";

export const authOptions: NextAuthOptions = {
  providers: [
    CredentialsProvider({
      name: "Credentials",
      credentials: {
        email: { label: "Email", type: "email" },
        password: { label: "Password", type: "password" }
      },
      async authorize(credentials) {
        if (!credentials?.email || !credentials?.password) {
          return null;
        }

        const db = await DatabaseService.getDb();
        const user = await db.collection("users").findOne({ email: credentials.email });

        if (!user || !user.password) {
          return null;
        }

        const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare(credentials.password, user.password);

        if (!isPasswordValid) {
          return null;
        }

        return {
          id: user._id.toString(),
          name: user.fullName,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
        };
      }
    })
  ],
  session: {
    strategy: "jwt",
    maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60, // 30 days
  },
  callbacks: {
    async jwt({ token, user }) {
      if (user) {
        token.id = user.id;
        token.role = user.role;
      }
      return token;
    },
    async session({ session, token }) {
      if (session.user) {
        session.user.id = token.id;
        session.user.role = token.role;
      }
      return session;
    }
  },
  pages: {
    signIn: "/auth/login",
    error: "/auth/error",
  },
};
```

### Type Definitions
The NextAuth session types are extended in `app/types/next-auth.d.ts` to include additional properties:

```typescript
import NextAuth, { DefaultSession } from "next-auth";

declare module "next-auth" {
  interface Session {
    user: {
      id: string;
      role: string;
    } & DefaultSession["user"];
  }

  interface User {
    id: string;
    role: string;
  }
}
```

### Usage in API Routes
API routes should verify authentication before processing requests:

```typescript
import { getServerSession } from "next-auth/next";
import { authOptions } from "@/app/lib/auth-options";

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
    
  if (!session || !session.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  }
  
  const userId = session.user.id;
  // Process request...
}
```

## Component Library

MedConnect uses a component-based architecture with reusable components stored in `app/components/`.

### Key Components
- `Button` - Reusable button with variants
- `Card` - Container for content with consistent styling
- `Input` - Form input with validation
- `Select` - Dropdown select with options
- `Modal` - Popup dialog
- `Tabs` - Tab navigation component
- `Alert` - Status alerts and notifications
- `Avatar` - User avatars
- `Badge` - Status indicators
- `Loader` - Loading spinners

### Page Layouts
- `DashboardLayout` - Layout for dashboard pages
- `AuthLayout` - Layout for authentication pages

### Example Usage
```tsx
import Button from '@/app/components/Button';
import Card from '@/app/components/Card';

export default function AppointmentCard({ appointment }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">{appointment.doctorName}</h3>
      <p className="text-gray-600">{appointment.date} {appointment.startTime}</p>
      <div className="mt-4">
        <Button variant="primary">Reschedule</Button>
        <Button variant="outline" className="ml-2">Cancel</Button>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Testing

### Unit Testing
MedConnect uses Jest for unit testing. To run tests:

```bash
npm run test
```

### Component Testing
React Testing Library is used for component testing:

```tsx
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import AppointmentCard from './AppointmentCard';

describe('AppointmentCard', () => {
  it('renders appointment details correctly', () => {
    const appointment = {
      doctorName: 'Dr. Smith',
      date: '2023-06-15',
      startTime: '10:00',
    };
    
    render(<AppointmentCard appointment={appointment} />);
    
    expect(screen.getByText('Dr. Smith')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('2023-06-15 10:00')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

### API Testing
Supertest is used for API testing:

```typescript
import { createRequest, createResponse } from 'node-mocks-http';
import { GET } from '@/app/api/appointments/route';

jest.mock('next-auth/next', () => ({
  getServerSession: jest.fn(() => ({
    user: { id: 'test-user-id' }
  }))
}));

describe('Appointments API', () => {
  it('returns appointments for authenticated user', async () => {
    const req = createRequest({
      method: 'GET',
      url: '/api/appointments',
    });
    const res = createResponse();
    
    await GET(req, res);
    
    expect(res._getStatusCode()).toBe(200);
    expect(JSON.parse(res._getData())).toHaveProperty('appointments');
  });
});
```

## Deployment

### Production Build
To create a production build:

```bash
npm run build
```

### Environment Variables
The following environment variables are required for deployment:

- `MONGODB_URI` - MongoDB connection string
- `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` - Secret for NextAuth.js
- `NEXTAUTH_URL` - URL for NextAuth.js

### Deployment Platforms
MedConnect can be deployed to:

- Vercel (recommended for Next.js)
- Netlify
- AWS Amplify
- Self-hosted servers

## Future Development

### Roadmap
1. **Phase 1: Health Passport Foundation** (Current)
   - Core authentication
   - Patient dashboard
   - Health passport functionality
   - Basic appointment scheduling

2. **Phase 2: Enhanced Patient Experience**
   - Doctor discovery and search
   - Advanced appointment booking
   - In-app video consultations
   - Rating and review system

3. **Phase 3: Provider Integration**
   - Doctor portal
   - Pharmacy integration
   - Lab integration
   - Insurance verification

4. **Phase 4: Advanced Features**
   - AI-powered symptom checker
   - Personalized health insights
   - Wearable device integration
   - Telehealth platform

### Adding New Features
When adding new features:

1. Create a new branch from `main`
2. Implement the feature with appropriate tests
3. Update documentation as needed
4. Submit a pull request for review

### Performance Considerations
- Use server-side rendering where appropriate
- Optimize data fetching with SWR or React Query
- Implement code splitting for large components
- Optimize image delivery
- Monitor and analyze client-side performance

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const API_KEY = 'AIzaSyCrU95g64dkZ16WP9-sYlJPxdH38u0ej9A';

            const clearButton = document.getElementById('clear');
            // Enable submitting when pressing Enter (but Shift+Enter for new line)
            promptTextarea.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    submitMessage();
                }
            });
            submitButton.addEventListener('click', submitMessage);
            clearButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const aiMessage = conversationElement.firstElementChild;
                conversationElement.innerHTML = '';
                conversationElement.appendChild(aiMessage);
                localStorage.removeItem('medconnect_conversation');
            });
            // Load conversation from localStorage if available
            const savedConversation = localStorage.getItem('medconnect_conversation');
            if (savedConversation) {
                const parsedConversation = JSON.parse(savedConversation);
                for (const message of parsedConversation) {
                    if (message.role === 'user') {
                        addUserMessage(message.content);
                    } else if (message.role === 'assistant') {
                        addAIMessage(message.content);
                    }
                }
            }
            function setQuestion(question) {
                promptTextarea.value = question;
                promptTextarea.focus();
                // Adjust height
                promptTextarea.style.height = '';
                promptTextarea.style.height = Math.min(promptTextarea.scrollHeight, 150) + 'px';
            }
            function formatTimestamp() {
                const now = new Date();
                const hours = now.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
                const minutes = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
                return `${hours}:${minutes}`;
            }
            function addUserMessage(text) {
                const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
                messageElement.className = 'message user';
                messageElement.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="avatar user">
                        <i class="fas fa-user"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <div class="message-text">${text}</div>
                        <div class="message-time">${formatTimestamp()}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
                conversationElement.appendChild(messageElement);
                scrollToBottom();
                saveConversation();
            }
            function addAIMessage(text) {
                const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
                messageElement.className = 'message ai';
                messageElement.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="avatar ai">
                        <i class="fas fa-robot"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <div class="message-text">${text}</div>
                        <div class="message-time">${formatTimestamp()}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
                conversationElement.appendChild(messageElement);
                scrollToBottom();
                saveConversation();
            }
            function scrollToBottom() {
                conversationElement.scrollTop = conversationElement.scrollHeight;
            }
            function saveConversation() {
                const messages = Array.from(conversationElement.children).map(child => {
                    const isUser = child.classList.contains('user');
                    const text = child.querySelector('.message-text').textContent;
                    return {
                        role: isUser ? 'user' : 'assistant',
                        content: text
                    };
                });
                localStorage.setItem('medconnect_conversation', JSON.stringify(messages));
            }
            async function submitMessage() {
                const promptText = promptTextarea.value.trim();
                if (!promptText) return;
                // Add user message to conversation
                addUserMessage(promptText);
                // Clear textarea and resize
                promptTextarea.value = '';
                promptTextarea.style.height = 'auto';
                // Disable submit button and show loading
                submitButton.disabled = true;
                loadingElement.style.display = 'flex';
                errorElement.style.display = 'none';
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            contents: [{
                                parts: [{
                                    text: `You are a health assistant. Provide helpful, accurate, and easy-to-understand information about health topics. For questions about specific medical conditions, always recommend consulting a healthcare professional for personalized advice.
Question: ${promptText}`
                                }]
                            }],
                            generationConfig: {
                                temperature: 0.4,
                                topK: 32,
                                topP: 0.95,
                                maxOutputTokens: 1024,
                            }
                        })
                    });
                    const data = await response.json();
                    if (data.candidates && data.candidates.length > 0 && 
                        data.candidates[0].content && 
                        data.candidates[0].content.parts && 
                        data.candidates[0].content.parts.length > 0) {
                        const aiResponse = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
                        addAIMessage(aiResponse);
                    } else if (data.error) {
                        errorElement.textContent = `Error: ${data.error.message || JSON.stringify(data.error)}`;
                        errorElement.style.display = 'block';
                    } else {
                        errorElement.textContent = 'Received an unexpected response format from the API.';
                        errorElement.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error:', error);
                    errorElement.textContent = `Error: ${error.message || error}`;
                    errorElement.style.display = 'block';
                } finally {
                    loadingElement.style.display = 'none';
                    submitButton.disabled = false;
                }
            }
            // Make the setQuestion function globally available
            window.setQuestion = setQuestion;
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
</file>

# MedConnect Phase 1 Completion: Health Passport Foundation

## Overview

We have successfully completed Phase 1 of the MedConnect project, which focused on implementing the Health Passport Foundation. This phase establishes the core functionality for users to create, manage, and share their health passports, laying the groundwork for future phases of the project.

## Implemented Components

### Data Models

- Created comprehensive data models for the Health Passport feature, including:
  - Health Passport core structure
  - Medical Records
  - Vital Signs
  - Vaccinations
  - Allergies
  - Emergency Contacts
  - Access Logs

### Services

- Implemented the Health Passport Service with the following functionalities:
  - Creating and managing health passports
  - Adding, updating, and deleting medical records
  - Managing vital signs
  - Generating access codes for QR codes
  - Controlling access to health passports
  - Searching for health passports

### API Endpoints

Created a comprehensive set of RESTful API endpoints:

#### Health Passport Management
- `POST /api/health-passport/create` - Create a new health passport
- `GET /api/health-passport/[user_id]` - Get a health passport by user ID
- `GET /api/health-passport/[passport_id]` - Get a health passport by passport ID
- `PUT /api/health-passport/[passport_id]` - Update a health passport
- `DELETE /api/health-passport/[passport_id]` - Delete a health passport (soft delete)

#### Medical Records
- `GET /api/health-passport/[passport_id]/records` - Get all medical records
- `POST /api/health-passport/[passport_id]/records` - Add a new medical record
- `GET /api/health-passport/[passport_id]/records/[record_id]` - Get a specific record
- `PUT /api/health-passport/[passport_id]/records/[record_id]` - Update a record
- `DELETE /api/health-passport/[passport_id]/records/[record_id]` - Delete a record

#### QR Code and Access
- `GET /api/health-passport/[passport_id]/qr-code` - Generate a QR code
- `POST /api/health-passport/access` - Access a passport using an access code

#### Search
- `GET /api/health-passport/search` - Search for health passports (providers/admins)

### Utility Functions

- Created utility functions to support the Health Passport feature:
  - Random string generation for access codes
  - Date formatting
  - QR code generation
  - Currency formatting
  - BMI calculation
  - Text truncation

## Security and Access Control

- Implemented robust authentication and authorization:
  - All endpoints require user authentication
  - Access control based on user roles and ownership
  - Temporary access via QR codes and access codes
  - Access logging for audit trails

## Documentation

- Created comprehensive API documentation:
  - Detailed endpoint descriptions
  - Request and response examples
  - Error handling information

## Next Steps

With Phase 1 complete, the project is ready to move on to Phase 2: Imaging Services Integration, which will build upon the foundation established in this phase.

### Upcoming Features for Phase 2:
- Integration with imaging service providers
- Scheduling and managing imaging appointments
- Storing and viewing imaging results
- Notifications for imaging appointments and results

## Conclusion

The successful completion of Phase 1 establishes a solid foundation for the MedConnect platform. The Health Passport feature provides users with a secure and convenient way to manage and share their health information, which is a core component of the platform's vision to create a patient-centric healthcare experience.
</file>

# Phase 2 Completion: Imaging Services Integration

## Overview

Phase 2 of the MedConnect project focused on implementing the Imaging Services Integration, covering weeks 7-12 of our development roadmap. This phase was crucial for expanding the platform's capabilities beyond the Health Passport foundation established in Phase 1.

## Completed Components

### 1. Data Models and Services

We successfully implemented the following data models:

- **Imaging Provider**: Facilities offering imaging services with details on location, specialties, and accepted insurance
- **Imaging Type**: Types of imaging services (MRI, CT, X-ray, etc.) with preparation instructions
- **Imaging Appointment**: Appointment scheduling with provider, type, date/time, and status
- **Imaging Result**: Diagnostic results with findings, images, and radiologist information

### 2. API Endpoints

We've created a comprehensive set of API endpoints:

#### Imaging Providers
- Routes for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting imaging providers
- Special endpoint for checking provider availability

#### Imaging Types
- Complete CRUD operations for managing different types of imaging services
- Includes detailed information on each imaging modality

#### Imaging Appointments
- Endpoints for scheduling, retrieving, updating, and canceling appointments
- Specialized endpoint for accessing imaging results for a specific appointment

#### Imaging Results
- Full set of endpoints for managing imaging diagnostic results
- Includes special functionality for marking results as viewed by patients or providers

### 3. Integration with Health Passport

- Connected imaging results to user health passports
- Ensured proper authorization checks between the two systems
- Implemented referencing between health passport and imaging services data

### 4. Authentication and Authorization

- Secured all endpoints with proper authentication checks
- Implemented role-based access control for different user types:
  - Patients can view their own appointments and results
  - Providers can access patient information with proper authorization
  - Admins have management capabilities across the system

### 5. Documentation

- Created comprehensive API documentation
- Documented request/response examples for all major endpoints
- Included error handling guidelines

## Technical Highlights

1. **MongoDB Integration**: Leveraged MongoDB's document database for flexible schema design
2. **NextJS API Routes**: Implemented API endpoints using Next.js API routes for optimal performance
3. **JWT Authentication**: Secured all endpoints with JWT token-based authentication
4. **Error Handling**: Implemented consistent error handling across all endpoints
5. **Conditional Access Control**: Built sophisticated permission checks for patient/provider access

## Future Enhancements for Phase 3

As we move into Phase 3, we'll build on the foundation by:

1. Implementing real-time notifications for imaging results
2. Creating a search API for patients to find imaging providers based on proximity and specialty
3. Adding integration with electronic health records systems
4. Developing reporting features for administrators and providers
5. Enhancing the mobile experience for patients accessing imaging results

## Conclusion

Phase 2 has successfully expanded the MedConnect platform with comprehensive imaging services functionality. The completed work enables users to:

- Find imaging providers based on location, specialty, and insurance acceptance
- Schedule imaging appointments with preparation instructions
- Receive and view imaging results securely
- Maintain all imaging history in their health passport

The implementation follows best practices for security, performance, and scalability, positioning the platform well for the next phase of development.
</file>

# Phase 3 Implementation Plan: User Experience Enhancements

## Overview

Phase 3 of the MedConnect project focuses on enhancing the user experience and expanding platform features beyond the core Health Passport (Phase 1) and Imaging Services (Phase 2). This phase will span weeks 13-18 of our development roadmap and will emphasize creating a more intuitive, responsive, and feature-rich experience for all users.

## Timeline

| Week | Focus Area | Key Deliverables |
|------|------------|------------------|
| 13   | Real-time Notifications | Notification system architecture, WebSocket integration |
| 14   | Patient Dashboard Enhancements | Customizable dashboard, Health insights, Action recommendations |
| 15   | Provider Portal Improvements | Patient management tools, Enhanced scheduling interface |
| 16   | Mobile Responsiveness | Mobile-optimized views, Progressive Web App features |
| 17   | Search & Discovery | Advanced search capabilities, Discovery features for providers |
| 18   | Testing & Optimization | Performance optimization, User acceptance testing |

## Detailed Implementation Plan

### Week 13: Real-time Notifications

#### Objectives:
- Implement a real-time notification system for important updates
- Create notification preferences for users
- Build notification center in the UI

#### Technical Implementation:
1. **Notification Service:**
   - Create notification models and database collections
   - Implement notification types (appointment, result, system)
   - Develop notification status management (read/unread)

2. **Real-time Infrastructure:**
   - Implement WebSocket connection using Socket.io
   - Create notification events and handlers
   - Build notification queue for offline users

3. **Notification UI Components:**
   - Create notification badge and counter
   - Implement notification drawer/panel
   - Build notification settings page

#### API Endpoints:
- `GET /api/notifications` - Get user notifications
- `PATCH /api/notifications/:id` - Mark notification as read
- `PUT /api/notifications/settings` - Update notification preferences
- `DELETE /api/notifications/:id` - Delete a notification

### Week 14: Patient Dashboard Enhancements

#### Objectives:
- Create a customizable dashboard for patients
- Implement health insights based on passport data
- Add action recommendations based on health data

#### Technical Implementation:
1. **Dashboard Customization:**
   - Create dashboard layout manager
   - Implement draggable/resizable widgets
   - Save user dashboard preferences

2. **Health Insights Engine:**
   - Develop data analysis algorithms for health trends
   - Create visualization components for health data
   - Implement comparison with health standards

3. **Action Recommendations:**
   - Build recommendation engine based on health data
   - Implement suggestion cards for appointments/tests

#### API Endpoints:
- `GET /api/dashboard/widgets` - Get available dashboard widgets
- `PUT /api/dashboard/layout` - Update dashboard layout
- `GET /api/health-insights` - Get personalized health insights
- `GET /api/recommendations` - Get personalized action recommendations

### Week 15: Provider Portal Improvements

#### Objectives:
- Enhance the provider experience with better patient management
- Improve scheduling interface for providers
- Add clinical note-taking capabilities

#### Technical Implementation:
1. **Enhanced Patient Management:**
   - Create patient list with filtering and search
   - Implement patient summary cards
